answer: Resist sybils with a scarce lookout, not a signup fee. Every identity may hold one raven post — a signed watch over a randomly assigned work sector — and the post counts only when three settled, non-overlapping peers corroborate its sightings. Sectors form a public tundra of fixed slots, so a thousand aliases need a thousand posts. Every six hours a gale audit samples confirmers; if they cluster as fresh keys, the bond burns and the slot is released. Fake flocks then cost real, unshareable watch time.
